verdict.rationale: Polar ships a first-party remote MCP server (production and sandbox endpoints, OAuth sign-in) that lets AI agents look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits. Setup is documented for ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor, so a user can run the product through natural-language prompts in those clients. The probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: no native natural-language interface inside Polar itself (it relies on an external AI client), no list of which actions the MCP tools cover, no independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
